Podiel hlasovaní, pri ktorých poslanec n: Share of votes at which the MP was not recorded as absent. An absence counts as excused if the MP has an excuse recorded for that day on nrsr.sk; an unexcused absence can also be a short absence during a sitting day.
Podiel hlasovaní, v ktorých poslanec hla: Share of votes in which the MP voted with the caucus majority (only for, against and abstain count). The caucus is taken as it was at the time of the vote. If the caucus had no clear majority, the vote is not counted. Loyalty is not calculated for independent MPs.
Podiel hlasovaní, v ktorých dvaja poslan: Share of votes in which two MPs voted the same way, among those where both voted for, against or abstained (at least {n} shared votes).
„Schválený“ alebo „neschválený“ podľa zá: “Passed” or “rejected” according to the final third-reading vote (for resolutions, elections and reports, the last vote). “In progress” with activity in the last {n} months, otherwise “no final vote”. The official progress, including the Collection of Laws number, comes from nrsr.sk.
Tesné hlasovanie je také, o ktorom rozho: A close vote is one decided by at most {n} votes. Caucus cohesion is the Rice/Hix agreement index: {n} % means all members voted the same way.
Slová, ktoré poslanec v rozprave používa: Words an MP uses in debate much more often than others, computed with TF-IDF from the stenographic transcripts, excluding proper names, procedural phrases and the chair's remarks.
Ospravedlnenia, návrhy zákonov, pozmeňuj: Excuses, bills, amendments, interpellations, trips abroad, offices, committees and membership changes come from nrsr.sk and are refreshed about once a week.
Z oznámení verejných funkcionárov uvádza: From public officials' declarations we show income, positions, employment, business activity and the types and numbers of assets. We deliberately do not show exact property locations (cadastral areas, title deeds); the full declaration is available via the link to nrsr.sk.
Pri dlhších vystúpeniach zobrazujeme krá: For longer speeches we show a short summary marked “AI summary”. It is written by a language model (GitHub Models) solely from the official transcript, instructed to stay impartial and add nothing. A summary may be inaccurate; the full transcript is authoritative. Summaries are in Slovak.
Prezentácie (kontroly prítomnosti) neuvá: Attendance checks are left out of the statistics because nothing is decided in them. Caucuses in the chamber are ordered by size, and their colours are neutral, not party colours.
Nie. Faktická poznámka je nezávislý proj: No. Faktická poznámka is an independent project with no ties to the National Council, the government or political parties. If a figure differs from nrsr.sk, nrsr.sk prevails.
Hlasovania a rozprava sa kontrolujú každ: Votes and debate are checked every hour on working days. MP activity, committees and asset declarations about once a week.
Áno. Kód aj dáta sú verejné na GitHube a: Yes. Code and data are public on GitHub and you may use them freely; crediting the source is appreciated.
